repositories: Create disposable local bare source and destination repositories for each configuration; no network endpoints.
history: Commit a synthetic credential formed by joining sk- with seven repetitions of a1B2 in content.txt.
Replace content.txt with ordinary text and commit the removal.
tracking: Populate source with that history and fetch it as origin/main so the tracking ref reaches the clean final tip.

configurations.separate-push-url: Leave origin's fetch URL pointing to source; set its push URL to an empty destination.
configurations.retargeted-remote: After fetching source, change origin's URL to an empty destination without removing the existing tracking ref.

control: Push a branch containing only ordinary content to a separate empty local destination with the same gate and policy.
